title: Arbitrary p-adic lifts carry no discrete-log information when #E(F_p) != p
question:
For E/F_p with prime-order subgroup

of order r != p, the Smart-style quantity psi(P~) = (-x/y)([#E]P~)/p mod p computed from arbitrary lifts P~, Q~ in E~(Q_p) does not satisfy psi(Q~) = k psi(P~) mod p beyond chance, i.e. it carries no information about k.
rationale: Registered by PI from sealed round-1 submissions before cross-agent synthesis or review.
claims:
For E/F_p with prime-order subgroup

of order r != p, the Smart-style quantity psi(P~) = (-x/y)([#E]P~)/p mod p computed from arbitrary lifts P~, Q~ in E~(Q_p) does not satisfy psi(Q~) = k psi(P~) mod p beyond chance, i.e. it carries no information about k.
notes: Origin: A4 + E3 control (RUN-b0ccd1bd), B4 (RUN-fec2442f). Agent A reported its own prediction for the control was falsified (nonzero lift-dependent values) and reinterpreted; needs independent test. | ECDLP-5: ill-posed quantifier. Under the universal reading ("arbitrary lifts" includes consistent lifts Q~=[k]P~) the statement is false: psi(Q~)=k psi(P~) exactly. Under the independent-random-lift reading it holds exactly (uniform on F_p^2; HYP-f85d20a1). Anomalous control 504/504 recoveries.
